name: ohmyjev
description: Jev for Claude Code: Bash and Write gates, an injection screen, and a done-check, decided by TypeSafe's Jev.

jevModel.title: Jev model (TypeSafe)
jevModel.description: Model id sent to the TypeSafe endpoint

enabled.title: ohmyjev on
enabled.description: Off lets every call through. /omj off and /omj on change it for one session

writeGate.title: Write gate
writeGate.description: Deny writes outside the repo/allowPaths and writes holding credentials

injectionScreen.title: Injection screen
injectionScreen.description: Warn the model when Bash, WebFetch or MCP output carries instructions aimed at it

doneCheck.title: Done-check
doneCheck.description: Push back once when the agent claims done without verifying

exfilGate.title: Exfil gate
exfilGate.description: Deny WebFetch and MCP calls that send local data, files or credentials out

screenReads.title: Screen Reads outside the repo
screenReads.description: Run the injection screen on files read from outside the repo

bashIrreversible.title: Bash: irreversible confidence to deny
bashIrreversible.description: Deny when Jev rates the command irreversible at least this confident (0-1)

bashDestructive.title: Bash: destructive-intent to deny
bashDestructive.description: Deny when destructive intent is at least this probable (0-1)

writeSecret.title: Write: credential probability to deny
writeSecret.description: Deny when the content holds a credential at least this probable (0-1)

writeSecretsKind.title: Write: secrets-file confidence to deny
writeSecretsKind.description: Deny when the file is a secrets file at least this confident (0-1)

injection.title: Injection probability to flag
injection.description: Flag tool output as an injection at this probability (0-1)

exfil.title: Exfil probability to deny
exfil.description: Deny when Jev rates the call as sending local data out at least this probable (0-1)

requested.title: Let through what you asked for
requested.description: A gate's Jev deny passes when Jev rates your latest message as asking for exactly that call at least this probable (0-1). Policy and path denies always stand

doneClaimed.title: Done-check: claimed-done at least
doneClaimed.description: Check only when Jev says done was claimed at least this probable (0-1)

doneVerifiedMax.title: Done-check: verified below
doneVerifiedMax.description: Push back when verified is below this (0-1)

doneAsksUserMax.title: Done-check: asks-user below
doneAsksUserMax.description: Skip when the reply asks the user something at or above this (0-1)

askJev.title: ask_jev tool
askJev.description: Give the model an ask_jev tool for quick judgments about repo files or text without reading them into context

autoCompact.title: Auto-compact
autoCompact.description: Compact when Jev sees the task change at a natural boundary, keeping the new request in detail

compactSwitched.title: Auto-compact: task-switch probability
compactSwitched.description: Compact when the request switched tasks at least this probable (0-1)

compactBoundary.title: Auto-compact: boundary probability
compactBoundary.description: …and the last turn finished a unit of work at least this probable (0-1)

compactMinPercent.title: Auto-compact: minimum context %
compactMinPercent.description: Only compact once the context is at least this full (0-100)

routeEffort.title: Router: effort
routeEffort.description: Raise or lower reasoning effort per turn from Jev's read of the request

routeSubagents.title: Router: subagent model
routeSubagents.description: Pick the subagent model (fast/balanced/deep) from the request

routeMainModel.title: Router: main model
routeMainModel.description: Also switch the main model per turn (discards the warm prompt cache)

routeUpgrade.title: Router: confidence to move up
routeUpgrade.description: Raise effort or tier at this confidence or above (0-1)

routeDowngrade.title: Router: confidence to move down
routeDowngrade.description: Lower effort or tier at this confidence or above (0-1)

routeRisky.title: Router: risky forces deep
routeRisky.description: At this probability a request touching prod, money or credentials goes deep with at least high effort (0-1)

routeWithoutKey.title: Router: built-in classifier without a key
routeWithoutKey.description: With no Jev key, route with Claude Code's own small model; it reports no confidence, so it only routes up

fastModel.title: Fast model
fastModel.description: Model id for the fast tier

balancedModel.title: Balanced model
balancedModel.description: Model id for the balanced tier

deepModel.title: Deep model
deepModel.description: Model id for the deep tier

allowPaths.title: Allowed write paths outside the repo

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Your own rules every gate weighs, separated by ; (e.g. never touch prod; no deploys on Friday)

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long a gate, screen or the router waits for Jev before letting the call through

logDecisions.title: Show decisions in the transcript
logDecisions.description: Dim lines (never sent to the model) with each routing decision, its confidence and latency

statusLine.title: Status under the prompt
statusLine.description: Pin jev's calls, denies and route under the prompt; no statusline script needed
